export_rights.summary: No Paylocity terms of service, DPA, or export-policy page could be consulted (all paylocity.com web properties were unreachable from the research environment), so no contractual statement of customer export rights or post-termination retrieval window is documented here. The vendor-published Web Services API specification establishes that a customer (or its authorized integration) can programmatically retrieve employee, payroll, and pay-statement data 'currently available in Web Pay' using Paylocity-provisioned API credentials.

routes.how: Paylocity Web Services API v2 (base https://api.paylocity.com/api). Auth: OAuth 2.0 client-credentials — POST https://api.paylocity.com/IdentityServer/connect/token with Basic auth (client-id:client-secret base64), Content-Type application/x-www-form-urlencoded, body grant_type=client_credentials&scope=WebLinkAPI; returns a bearer token (expires_in 3600). Then GET /v2/companies/{companyId}/employees/ (paged: pagesize default 25, pagenumber 0-based, total count in X-Pcty-Total-Count response header), GET /v2/companies/{companyId}/employees/{employeeId}, .../employees/{employeeId}/earnings, .../employees/{employeeId}/localTaxes, .../employees/{employeeId}/paystatement/summary/{year}[/{checkDate}] and .../paystatement/details/{year}[/{checkDate}]. Sandbox token endpoint: https://apisandbox.paylocity.com/IdentityServer/connect/token.
requires: API client credentials provisioned by Paylocity: submit the Paylocity Web Services Access Request form (docs.paylocity.com) to webservices@paylocity.com; Paylocity sets the scope (request types and allowed company numbers)
Client secret expires every 365 days and must be renewed (renewal code emailed 10 and 5 days before expiry, or via POST /v2/credentials/secrets)
routes.rate_limits: No numeric limits published in the API spec; Paylocity states it 'reserves the right to impose rate limits on the number of calls made to our APIs' and may change API features/functionality at any time with or without notice.
gotchas: Read surface is per-employee: earnings, local-tax, and pay-statement GETs require iterating employee IDs obtained from the paged Get All Employees call
No endpoints for documents/attachments, time-and-labor punches, or audit logs exist in the published v2 spec
Pay-statement endpoints return JSON data, not PDF check stubs
API returns only data 'currently available in Web Pay'; historical data availability is not specified
v1 endpoints remain supported but receive no new functionality; deductions data is documented only under the v1 API
Optional RSA/AES request-payload encryption is part of the setup (Paylocity-issued public key); clients can opt out during initial setup

routes.how: Same Web Services API v2 and token flow as the primary route: GET https://api.paylocity.com/api/v2/companies/{companyId}/codes/{codeResource} returns all company codes for the selected code resource; GET /v2/companies/{companyId}/customfields/{category} returns custom fields for the category. Read-only JSON reference data, not a restorable configuration package.
requires: Same Paylocity-provisioned WebLinkAPI client credentials as the primary API route
routes.rate_limits: Same unspecified reserved-right rate limiting as the primary API route.
gotchas: Valid values for {codeResource} and {category} are not enumerated in the mirrored spec text consulted — confirm against current vendor docs before relying on coverage
No documented export of workflows, report definitions, security roles, or other tenant configuration as restorable artifacts

preservation_notes.config_artifacts: Partial and read-only: company code tables (GET /v2/companies/{companyId}/codes/{codeResource}) and custom field definitions (GET /v2/companies/{companyId}/customfields/{category}) are retrievable as JSON via the Web Services API. No documented export of workflows, report definitions, or other customizations as restorable artifacts.

notes: Research-environment caveats: the WebSearch budget was exhausted before this recipe was researched, and the network egress proxy blocked every Paylocity web property (www/docs/developer/help/api hosts) plus general web hosts, so nothing could be fetched from Paylocity directly. All API claims derive from GitHub mirrors of the vendor-published OpenAPI spec (self-declared origin https://api.paylocity.com/api/v2/openapi); the mirrors are dated (Swagger 2.0 era), so the current API surface on developer.paylocity.com is likely larger and should be re-checked from an unrestricted network. Consequences of the blockade, not of the product: no route is recorded for admin-UI/report-writer exports (Paylocity's reporting and Data Insights features could not be documented from any citable source), for attachment/document bulk export, or for audit-log export — these are honest unknowns, not confirmed absences. No terms/DPA statement of export rights or post-termination window could be consulted. Third-party connector docs (Nango) additionally describe a newer 'NextGen' API surface behind gateway hosts dc1prodgwext.paylocity.com (prod) / dc1demogwext.paylocity.com (test) and note that API setup may carry a cost and is permissioned per the access-request form — unverified against vendor documentation.
